title: Claim/service covered by another payer (COB)
description: Check primary payer EOB/ERA.
Verify COB loops in your PM system.
Post primary payment and adjustments.
Prepare secondary claim with correct COB info.
Submit as a new claim (not a replacement).
Document resolution in patient notes.

title: Not Medically Necessary
description: Check LCD/NCD for procedure.
Review documentation (pain scale, imaging, conservative treatment).
Appeal with supporting records if criteria met.
Adjust if truly non-covered.

title: Precertification / Authorization Required
description: Verify authorization requirements per payer.
Confirm CPT, units, and date range match authorization.
Obtain retroactive authorization if allowed.
Submit corrected claim or appeal with authorization.

title: Bundled Service
description: Review CPT bundling rules.
Verify modifier usage (59, XE, XS, XU).
Correct and resubmit if allowed.

title: Missing / Invalid Information
description: Verify newborn member ID and date of birth.
Confirm claim billed under correct subscriber.
Correct and resubmit as new claim.

title: Timely Filing Limit Exceeded
description: Check payer filing limits.
Verify newborn enrollment delay.
Appeal with proof if applicable.

title: Unprocessable claim due to missing/invalid info
description: Identify missing or incorrect information on the claim.
Correct the claim details.
Submit as a new claim (do not appeal).
Document steps in the patient record.

title: Charge exceeds fee schedule / contracted maximum
description: Check payer’s fee schedule.
Compare billed charge to allowed amount.
Post adjustment for the difference.
Do not bill patient for CO-45.

title: Coinsurance
description: Identify patient responsibility per ERA/EOB.
Check if patient is Medicare/QMB — may not be billable.
Post coinsurance in PM system if allowed.
Document any adjustments or write-offs.

title: Copay
description: Identify copay from secondary payer ERA/EOB.
Check if patient is Medicare/QMB — may not be billable.
Post copay in PM system if allowed.
Document in patient account notes.
